answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 66 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes an opal bet on surviving 66 epochs of grading, and every basalt settlement recomputes the cipher schedule, so an adversary who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 13 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
